items.title: Chapter 1: What Is Design and Architecture?
items.description: Martin demolishes the false distinction between "design" and "architecture", then presents the singular goal of software architecture: minimizing the human effort required to build and maintain a system.

items.title: Database Design & Normalization
items.description: Entity-Relationship modeling, normal forms (1NF through BCNF), denormalization trade-offs, and schema design patterns.

items.title: REST, gRPC & API Design
items.description: REST principles and constraints, gRPC and Protocol Buffers, GraphQL, API versioning, pagination, idempotency, and API design best practices.
